ModMetaData.name: HD5500 Bridge - tick-rate counter
ModMetaData.author: HD5500 GPU Bridge
ModMetaData.description: Read-only diagnostic for the HD5500 GPU Bridge: measures game ticks per real second against the target (60 x speed) and writes them to a CSV and the log. No patches, no gameplay changes. Loaded by the bridge launcher only for test runs (-mod=).
